title: Giant Aerosol Observations with Cloud Radar: Methodology and Effects
content: In this study, an innovative methodology for the identification of giant aerosols using cloud radar is introduced. The methodology makes use of several insects studies and is applied to a 6-year long cloud radar dataset in Potenza, South Italy. 40 giant aerosol events per year were found and are in good agreement with the site’s climatological record. A sensitivity study on the effects of the giant aerosols on three atmospheric variables and under different atmospheric stability conditions showed that the presence of giant aerosols: a) increased the Aerosol Optical Depth in all the atmospheric stability conditions, b) decreased the Ångström exponent for the highest and lowest stability conditions and had the opposite effect for the intermediate stability condition, and c) increased the accumulated precipitation in all the atmospheric conditions, specially in the most unstable ones.
